step1_analysis.description: A 10-transistor SRAM cell designed for output prediction. It features a standard 6T cross-coupled core (with write access transistors disabled in this specific extraction by grounding their gates) and decoupled read ports controlled by prediction lines (PRED/PREDB) to reduce bitline switching activity.

paper_reference.title: An SRAM Using Output Prediction to Reduce BL-Switching Activity and Statistically-Gated SA for up to 1.9× Reduction in Energy/Access

read_delay.description: Time from the prediction line (PREDB) falling to the bitline (BL) discharging to a threshold voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 50fF bitline capacitance and ~100uA read current through the read port, dt = C * dV / I = 50fF * 0.2V / 100uA = 100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the assumed bitline capacitance and the drive strength of the read port NMOS in SKY130 at 1.8V.

read_power.description: Average power consumption of the cell during the read operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Read current flows through the diode-connected load and read port. I ~ 100uA. P = V * I = 1.8V * 100uA = 180uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for a single cell at 1.8V in SKY130. The 1W reported in the paper is for the entire SRAM macro, not a single cell.

leakage_power.description: Static power consumption of the SRAM cell when idle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Leakage of the cross-coupled inverters. With W=5u, L=0.5u, I_leak ~ 100pA. P = 1.8V * 100pA = 180pW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard subthreshold leakage for thick-oxide 1.8V devices in SKY130.

bl_swing.description: Minimum voltage reached by the bitline during a read operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between the diode-connected pull-up (XM8) and the read port pull-down (XM9). Both are W=5u, L=0.5u. BL will settle around 0.5V-0.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the ratio of the pull-up diode and the pull-down read stack.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure read delay, bitline swing, read power, and leakage power of the SRAM cell during a read operation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SRAM Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 Q QB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QB Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 QB Q GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 BLB QB PRED GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 Q QB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 BLB 0 QB GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 BL 0 Q GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 1 1 BL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 BL Q PREDB GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 1 1 BLB GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V1 1 0 1.8

* Bitline capacitance
CBL BL 0 50f
CBLB BLB 0 50f

* Prediction lines (Read Wordlines)
* Idle at 1.8V, pulse low to read
VPRED PRED 0 1.8
VPREDB PREDB 0 PULSE(1.8 0 2n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 10n)

* Initialize SRAM cell state (Q=1, QB=0)
.ic v(Q)=1.8 v(QB)=0 v(BL)=1.2 v(BLB)=1.2

.control
  tran 10p 6n
  
  * Measure Read Delay on BL
  meas tran t_read trig v(PREDB) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(BL) val=1.1 fall=1
  
  * Measure Bitline Swing
  meas tran bl_min min v(BL)
  
  * Measure Read Power
  meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VVDD) from=2n to=4n
  meas tran i_v1_avg avg i(V1) from=2n to=4n
  let read_power = -(i_vdd_avg + i_v1_avg) * 1.8
  print read_power
  
  * Measure Leakage Power
  meas tran i_vdd_leak avg i(VVDD) from=0.5n to=1.5n
  meas tran i_v1_leak avg i(V1) from=0.5n to=1.5n
  let leak_power = -(i_vdd_leak + i_v1_leak) * 1.8
  print leak_power
  
  quit
.endc
